latest.title: Updates for July 7, 2026
latest.body:
- Implement Fortnite and social feeds using free public data sources
- V3 public site overhaul with unified marketing layout
- Merge admin and staff portals into unified /admin
- Deelo v3: staff portal, RBAC, and dashboard overhaul
- Apply dashboard bot customization to Discord on save
- Fix embed colors for dashboard sends and bot replies
- Fix dashboard bot presence detection after redeploy
- Add embed builder, fix fun commands, and resolve embed/Last.fm routing clash
- Add premium bot appearance settings and fix web client bundle
- Add Discord channel dropdowns to the guild dashboard
- Fix dashboard layout overlap and animation glitches
- Fix dashboard profile avatars showing broken image icon
